blocks.text: When you step inside an Ayala Group facility, there’s a good chance it is powered by renewable electricity. At select BPI branches, it supports everyday banking. At Mapúa campuses, it powers spaces where students learn. Healthway medical facilities are also making the shift, bringing cleaner electricity into places where Filipinos receive care. Connecting these efforts is ACEN Renewable Energy Solutions (ACEN RES), the retail electricity supply arm of ACEN. It helps participating businesses source electricity from renewable energy assets. For Ayala Corporation, this is part of a broader push to encourage its businesses to work together and create greater value. By […]...
